title: Jester on Ornate Egg
description: A bearded jester in a colorful patchwork outfit and jester hat floats with arms raised above a large, intricately decorated mosaic egg. He emerges from swirling purple and blue smoke in a sunlit courtyard framed by stone arches covered in vibrant pink and orange flowering vines.
prompt: A joyful bearded jester wearing a multicolored patchwork outfit and pointed jester hat floats with arms outstretched above a large ornate egg covered in intricate turquoise, blue and gold mosaic patterns. He emerges from swirling purple and pink magical smoke and sparkles. The scene is set in a bright sunlit stone courtyard with Romanesque arches heavily draped in cascading pink and orange bougainvillea flowers, lush flower pots, warm golden light, highly detailed fantasy illustration.
